Together they earn less in a year than Nvidia makes in a week.

3. SambaNova. ~$2.5B raised. Not disclosed. $11B valuation in July.
4. Etched. ~$1.9B raised. Not disclosed. $21B valuation, first rack shipped in July.
5. Tenstorrent. $1B+ raised. Not disclosed. $2.6B valuation.
6. Lightmatter. $850M raised. Not disclosed. $4.4B valuation.

7511621065484222464.author: Ambar Laad
7511621065484222464.text:
The AI infrastructure conversation for the last two years has been about one thing: training. Nvidia GPUs, H100 clusters, data centres the size of small cities. Look at where the money actually went in Q3 2026. 

Inference-focused chip startups pulled 67% of all disclosed AI chip funding. $3.62B across eight deals. Etched, which builds chips hardwired exclusively to run AI models at inference time, took $700M alone.

The capital doesn't agree with the narrative.

Training gets the headlines because it's where the biggest numbers live. But training a model happens once. Serving it happens billions of times, forever, at a cost structure that determines whether the whole business is profitable.
